cost: Let H be bytes hashed and N tree entries, J JSON bytes and d feature count. Prepare/replay costs O(H+sum directory k log k+J+d^3); execution adds command duration and polling, output scans/hashes and repeated fingerprints; save requires serialization, file sync and directory sync. Memory includes model O(d^2), serialized JSON and per-directory maps. No duration guarantee follows from requested timeout.
forward: Parse command shape and spec; prepare validates, fingerprints and derives cohort, optionally verifies/replays a parent, then predicts. predict prints without spawning. run creates a fresh directory, copies binary, persists forecast before execution, checks local outputs/fingerprints, saves observation and only when accepted applies the library update and saves checkpoint. report projects stored evidence.
inverse: Behavior complement targets U minus R on the explicitly scoped observations.
Reverse reconstruction is a compatible antecedent relation; hashes, summaries and rounded arithmetic do not uniquely recover history.
limitations: Source-derived partial models; no semantic AST or full proof.

Filesystem errors may leave a partial ledger. Hashes assume collision resistance and trusted immutable reads; they do not authenticate data and are vulnerable to coordinated rewrites/TOCTOU. Explicit arbitrary commands are not sandboxed. There is no automatic search, teacher or shell interpreter, but caller can explicitly supply a shell executable. report validates stored hashes only when updated.json exists and does not replay the model.
